description: Structured specification table filtered by quantity (e.g. accuracy, wavelength, range), unit family, unit and value range, with source document and license. Paid ($0.001, x402).

family.description: Unit family: length, pressure, torque, force, temperature, frequency, power, voltage, current, mass, volume, time, percent

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

max.description: Maximum value, in the requested unit

min.description: Minimum value, in the requested unit

quantity.description: e.g. accuracy, resolution, range, wavelength, torque, temperature

query.description: Optional words the source document must contain

unit.description: Exact unit, e.g. nm, MPa, N·m

name: query_specs
title: Query the specification table
